payload.name: MongoDB Atlas
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Manage MongoDB Atlas and query your data. Connect to any MongoDB cluster or Atlas project to run queries and aggregations, inspect schemas and indexes, and read/write documents.

Key features:

* Query and manage data - Run finds, aggregations, and counts; insert, update, or delete documents; create collections and indexes.
* Manage Atlas infrastructure - Create and upgrade clusters, manage database users and IP access lists, and inspect cluster metadata across your projects and organizations.
* Optimize performance - Get index suggestions, schema recommendations, and slow query analysis from the Atlas Performance Advisor.
* Build streaming pipelines - Create, monitor, and manage Atlas Stream Processing workspaces, connections, and processors.
* Search MongoDB knowledge - Query official MongoDB documentation and expert guidance directly from the assistant knowledge base.
payload.longDescription:

* 查询和管理数据——运行查找、聚合和计数；插入、更新或删除文档；创建集合和索引。
* 管理 Atlas 基础设施——创建和升级集群，管理数据库用户和 IP 访问列表，并检查各项目和组织中的集群元数据。
* 优化性能——从 Atlas Performance Advisor 获取索引建议、架构建议和慢查询分析。
* 构建流处理管道——创建、监控和管理 Atlas Stream Processing 工作空间、连接和处理器。
* 搜索 MongoDB 知识——直接从助手知识库查询 MongoDB 官方文档和专家指导。

payload.name: Keenable

payload.longDescription:
Keenable 通过两个只读工具为 ChatGPT 提供实时网页访问。Web Search 会针对查询返回按排名排列的结果，每条结果包含标题、URL 和摘要。Fetch Page Content 可接收任意 URL，并以整洁的 Markdown 格式返回页面主要内容，让 ChatGPT 能读取刚刚找到的来源。

payload.name: Olostep

Reliable, cost-effective, and built to scale to billions of requests, Olostep lets you pull real-time web data directly into ChatGPT without managing browsers, proxies, or scrapers.
payload.longDescription: Olostep 将网页转化为适合 AI 使用的整洁结构化数据。你可以用自然语言搜索网页，将任意 URL 抓取为 Markdown、HTML、JSON 或截图，爬取整个网站，并获取基于网页来源的 AI 答案。Olostep 可靠、成本效益高，并可扩展至数十亿次请求，让你无需管理浏览器、代理或抓取工具，即可直接在 ChatGPT 中获取实时网页数据。

payload.name: WorkOS
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
WorkOS connects ChatGPT and Codex to your WorkOS workspace so you can manage your account in plain language. No dashboard required. 

Set up SSO and Directory Sync connections, create organizations and invite users, adjust auth policies, pull audit log events, and configure AuthKit branding. 

Ask "why can't this org sign in with SSO?" or "List every org with a draft SSO connection" and the agent discovers the right operation and runs it. 

Actions are scoped to the WorkOS team you authenticate with, using your existing dashboard permissions.
payload.longDescription:
WorkOS 将 ChatGPT 和 Codex 连接到你的 WorkOS 工作区，让你可以用日常语言管理账号，无需打开仪表板。

设置 SSO 和 Directory Sync 连接、创建组织并邀请用户、调整身份验证策略、提取审计日志事件，以及配置 AuthKit 品牌样式。

你可以询问“为什么这个组织无法通过 SSO 登录？”或“列出所有有 SSO 草稿连接的组织”，智能体会找到并执行合适的操作。

所有操作都限定在你进行身份验证的 WorkOS 团队范围内，并遵循你现有的仪表板权限。

payload.name: Soracom Knowledge

The server is hosted by Soracom as a shared, read-only endpoint—it only searches and reads documentation and does not modify any of your Soracom resources.
payload.longDescription: 按需搜索 Soracom 文档和 API 参考资料，查找服务指南、Soracom User Console 操作流程、定价、IoT 配方、API 参考、CLI 命令和 SAM 权限；答案以官方文档为依据，而非仅依赖训练数据。该服务器由 Soracom 托管，是一个共享的只读端点——只搜索和读取文档，不会修改你的任何 Soracom 资源。

payload.name: Engram
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Engram gives your AI assistant long-term memory. It stores your conversations verbatim and makes them searchable by meaning, so context, decisions, and preferences carry across sessions instead of being forgotten. Ask it to remember something and recall it days or weeks later. Your memory is private to your account and works across the MCP clients you connect.
payload.longDescription: Engram 为 AI 助手提供长期记忆。它逐字保存对话，并支持按含义搜索，让上下文、决策和偏好能够延续到不同会话中，不再轻易遗忘。你可以让它记住某件事，并在几天或几周后将其找回。你的记忆仅对你的账户私有，并可在你连接的 MCP 客户端之间使用。

payload.name: YepCode

Built for developers who need programmable, observable AI tool execution.

YepCode 让你使用自己的代码构建自定义 AI 工具。工具输入由 JSON Schema 定义，并在隔离沙箱中执行，可访问任意 npm 或 PyPI 软件包以及安全环境变量。

使用 Node.js 或 Python 定义可复用流程，将其作为可调用的 AI 工具公开，并按需或按计划执行。每次运行都会记录并可审计，支持可追溯的生产级 AI 集成。

专为需要可编程、可观测 AI 工具执行能力的开发者打造。

payload.name: Sticklight
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Sticklight is an AI-powered builder designed for professional web creators who want to build real digital products faster - without compromising on quality, control, or design standards.
You start by describing what you want to create in natural language, and Sticklight generates a working project with structure, interface, and core logic already in place. From there, creators can refine every detail - manually editing elements, adjusting layouts and interactions, and accessing the underlying code whenever needed. This allows professionals to keep full control over every pixel and maintain the level of craft their work demands.

What makes Sticklight especially valuable for experienced creators is the ability to produce non-generic results. Instead of templated outputs, the platform is designed to support custom design decisions and unique product ideas while still accelerating the building process. Creators can combine AI-assisted generation with their own expertise to deliver polished, high-quality experiences that are ready for real users and real traffic.

With Sticklight, creators can build complete applications - including dashboards, client portals, internal tools, MVPs, marketing platforms, and interactive products - not just static sites. The result is a stable, flexible environment where professionals can move from idea to fully functional application while maintaining the precision, reliability, and creative control their work requires.
payload.longDescription:
Sticklight 是一款由 AI 驱动的构建工具，面向希望更快打造真实数字产品、同时不牺牲质量、控制力或设计标准的专业网页创作者。
你只需用自然语言描述想要创建的内容，Sticklight 就会生成一个可运行的项目，预先搭建好结构、界面和核心逻辑。此后，创作者可以完善每个细节——手动编辑元素、调整布局和交互，并在需要时访问底层代码。这让专业人士能够完全掌控每个像素，并维持工作所要求的精细工艺水准。

Sticklight 对资深创作者尤其有价值，因为它能生成非模板化的结果。平台旨在支持自定义设计决策和独特产品创意，同时加快构建流程，而不是产出千篇一律的模板内容。创作者可以将 AI 辅助生成与自身专业能力结合，交付精致、高质量、可供真实用户使用并承载真实流量的体验。

使用 Sticklight，创作者可以构建完整应用，包括仪表板、客户门户、内部工具、MVP、营销平台和交互式产品，而不仅仅是静态网站。最终得到的是稳定且灵活的环境，让专业人士从创意推进到功能完备的应用，同时保持工作所需的精准、可靠和创作控制力。

payload.name: Themely Design+Style Generator
payload.description: 应用与网站界面设计灵感
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Create beautiful design themes for apps, websites, dashboards, landing pages, and more with AI. Describe what you want, explore different visual styles, compare ideas side by side, and preview your concepts in seconds. Whether you are starting from a blank page or refreshing an existing idea, this tool helps you quickly discover design directions without needing advanced design skills.

Simply tell ChatGPT what you want to build. You can ask for a mobile app, website, online store, portfolio, blog, dashboard, admin panel, marketing page, or almost any digital product. Then describe the feeling, audience, colors, or style you want. The AI turns your ideas into polished design themes that are easy to explore and refine.

Try many different looks without starting over. Generate clean, modern, minimal, playful, dark, colorful, premium, futuristic, glass, soft, bold, elegant, or creative themes. Compare different styles to find the one that best matches your project, brand, or personal taste. Small changes in your prompt can create fresh ideas that help you think in new ways.

Preview your ideas before spending time designing or building them. Seeing different themes early makes it easier to choose colors, layouts, typography, spacing, and overall visual direction. You can quickly decide what works and what does not before moving into design or development.

This tool is useful for designers, developers, founders, students, marketers, creators, agencies, and anyone who wants visual inspiration. It can help you explore ideas for business websites, startup landing pages, mobile apps, software dashboards, ecommerce stores, educational platforms, portfolios, travel sites, finance apps, health apps, productivity tools, entertainment services, and much more.

Use it when you need inspiration, want to overcome creative blocks, or simply want to see new possibilities. Generate many design directions in just a few moments instead of searching through endless galleries. Explore ideas that fit your goals and keep improving them until you find a style you love.

Experiment with color palettes, page layouts, interface styles, navigation, buttons, cards, forms, icons, sections, typography, and visual hierarchy. Ask for themes inspired by modern trends or timeless design principles. Mix different ideas together to create something unique for your own project.

The AI understands simple instructions, so you do not need special design words. Describe your project in everyday language. You can be detailed or brief. Ask for changes, request another style, or keep exploring until the result feels right. Every new prompt can lead to fresh concepts and unexpected ideas.

Whether you are planning your first website or improving a product used by thousands of people, this tool makes early design exploration faster and easier. It helps you discover themes, compare visual directions, and build confidence before investing time in detailed design work.

Perfect for brainstorming, creative exploration, product planning, design reviews, client presentations, prototypes, concept development, and visual inspiration. Turn simple ideas into attractive design themes, explore multiple possibilities, and find the look that best fits your project with the help of ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription:
借助 AI 为应用、网站、仪表板、落地页等创建精美设计主题。描述你的需求，探索不同视觉风格，并排比较创意，几秒钟内预览概念。无论你从空白页面开始，还是想焕新现有构想，此工具都能帮助你快速找到设计方向，无需高级设计技能。

只需告诉 ChatGPT 你想构建什么。你可以提出移动应用、网站、网店、作品集、博客、仪表板、管理后台、营销页面或几乎任何数字产品的需求。然后描述想要的感觉、受众、颜色或风格。AI 会将你的想法转化为精致的设计主题，供你轻松探索和完善。

无需从头开始，就能尝试多种外观。生成简洁、现代、极简、活泼、暗色、鲜艳、高级、未来感、玻璃质感、柔和、大胆、优雅或创意风格主题。比较不同风格，找到最符合项目、品牌或个人品味的方案。对提示稍作修改，就能产生新想法，帮助你换个角度思考。

在投入时间设计或开发前预览创意。尽早看到不同主题，有助于选择颜色、布局、字体、间距和整体视觉方向。进入设计或开发阶段前，你可以快速判断哪些有效、哪些不合适。

此工具适用于设计师、开发者、创业者、学生、营销人员、创作者、代理机构，以及任何需要视觉灵感的人。它可用于探索商业网站、初创公司落地页、移动应用、软件仪表板、电商商店、教育平台、作品集、旅游网站、金融应用、健康应用、效率工具、娱乐服务等构想。

当你需要灵感、想克服创意瓶颈，或只是想看看新的可能性时，可以使用它。无需在无穷无尽的图库中搜索，只需片刻即可生成多种设计方向。探索符合目标的创意，并持续改进，直到找到喜欢的风格。

尝试不同的配色方案、页面布局、界面风格、导航、按钮、卡片、表单、图标、版块、字体和视觉层级。你可以要求以现代趋势或经典设计原则为灵感的主题，也可以组合不同创意，为自己的项目打造独特风格。

AI 能理解简单指令，因此无需掌握专业设计术语。用日常语言描述项目即可，内容可以详细，也可以简短。你可以要求修改、尝试另一种风格，或继续探索，直到结果合适为止。每条新提示都可能带来新概念和意想不到的创意。

无论你是在规划第一个网站，还是改进已有数千用户的产品，此工具都能让早期设计探索更快、更轻松。它帮助你发现主题、比较视觉方向，并在投入详细设计前建立信心。

非常适合头脑风暴、创意探索、产品规划、设计评审、客户演示、原型制作、概念开发和视觉灵感。借助 ChatGPT，将简单想法转化为吸引人的设计主题，探索多种可能性，找到最适合项目的外观。

payload.name: Create State
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create State gives ChatGPT persistent memory for your software projects. Save code snippets, architectural decisions, and debugging insights to a personal knowledge graph. Pick up exactly where you left off in future conversations.
payload.longDescription: Create State 为软件项目提供 ChatGPT 持久记忆。将代码片段、架构决策和调试心得保存到个人知识图谱中，以便在之后的对话中准确接续工作。

payload.name: Adalo
payload.description: 构建和管理无代码应用
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Build and manage no-code apps entirely through conversation.  Adalo's ChatGPT integration lets you create, modify, and   manage mobile and web applications without ever leaving the    chat. Just describe what you want — Adalo's AI builds it   for you.
payload.longDescription: 完全通过对话构建和管理无代码应用。Adalo 的 ChatGPT 集成让你无需离开聊天，即可创建、修改和管理移动及网页应用。只需描述需求，Adalo 的 AI 就会为你构建。

payload.name: Context.dev
payload.summaryOriginal: Live web data for AI agents
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Context turns the live web and files into data inside ChatGPT. Search current information and optionally include page Markdown or relevant passages; search company news; scrape pages into HTML, Markdown, screenshots, images, original bytes, CSS-selected fields, highlights, JSON, or product data; map and crawl websites; parse documents; retrieve brand and person intelligence; inspect design systems; run scraping batches; monitor changes; and manage webhook deliveries.
payload.longDescription: Context将实时网络和文件转换为ChatGPT内的数据。搜索实时信息，并可选择包含页面Markdown或相关段落；搜索公司新闻；将页面抓取为HTML、Markdown、截图、图片、原始字节、CSS选择字段、高亮内容、JSON或产品数据；映射和爬取网站；解析文档；获取品牌与人物情报；检查设计系统；运行批量抓取；监控变更内容；管理Webhook交付。

payload.name: PageShare
payload.description: 分享并保护生成的 HTML
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: PageShare lets you share and protect HTML pages generated with ChatGPT. Publish new and update existing pages, control access with passwords or email rules, manage custom domains and tracking links, and review analytics for your sites.
payload.longDescription: PageShare 让你能够分享并保护使用 ChatGPT 生成的 HTML 页面。发布新页面并更新现有页面，通过密码或电子邮件规则控制访问，管理自定义域名和追踪链接，并查看网站分析数据。

payload.name: Catalyst by Zoho
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Catalyst by Zoho is a full-stack development platform for building web applications, APIs, automation workflows, and AI-powered software. The Codex plugin helps developers use Catalyst services directly from their coding workflow, making it easier to create backends, manage databases and storage, deploy applications, automate tasks, and integrate with Zoho and external services without switching between multiple tools.
payload.longDescription: Catalyst by Zoho 是一款全栈开发平台，用于构建 Web 应用、API、自动化工作流和 AI 软件。Codex 插件帮助开发者直接在编码工作流中使用 Catalyst 服务，从而更轻松地创建后端、管理数据库和存储、部署应用、自动执行任务，并与 Zoho 及外部服务集成，无需在多个工具之间切换。

payload.name: Jam
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Jam's MCP is the fast lane between Jam recordings and your dev tools. Drop a Jam link into ChatGPT, VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf, or Claude and the whole recording – video, console, network, logs – arrives pre-packaged. No hand-typing repro steps, no copy-paste stack traces, no screen-share drama. Your tools get instant context, you stay in flow.
payload.longDescription: Jam 的 MCP 是连接 Jam 录屏与开发工具的快捷通道。将 Jam 链接放入 ChatGPT、VS Code、Cursor、Windsurf 或 Claude，整段录制内容——视频、控制台、网络信息和日志——就会打包好并呈现。无需手动填写复现步骤、复制粘贴堆栈跟踪，也不必共享屏幕。你的工具能立即获得上下文，你可以持续专注工作。

payload.name: 3Min API
payload.description: 无需编程即可创建 API
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: 3Min API lets you create REST APIs without writing backend code. Define a JSON schema, and get full CRUD endpoints with automatic webhook delivery, sandbox/production separation, real-time logs, and usage statistics. Manage everything through natural language — create endpoints, test API calls, search logs, invite collaborators, deploy to production, and generate ready-to-paste WordPress plugin snippets that render your endpoints on any WordPress page.
payload.longDescription: 3Min API 让你无需编写后端代码即可创建 REST API。定义 JSON 架构，就能获得完整的 CRUD 端点，以及自动 webhook 传送、沙盒与生产环境分离、实时日志和使用统计。通过自然语言管理一切——创建端点、测试 API 调用、搜索日志、邀请协作者、部署到生产环境，以及生成可直接粘贴的 WordPress 插件代码片段，在任意 WordPress 页面呈现你的端点。

payload.name: Hot100.ai
payload.description: 每周 AI 项目榜单
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Hot100 lets you search and browse hundreds of AI projects, tools, and agents. Ranked weekly and tagged by stack, use case, and builder tools like Cursor & Replit. Find inspiration, explore what’s shipping, and stay on top of the AI ecosystem.
payload.longDescription: Hot100 可让你搜索和浏览数百个 AI 项目、工具和智能体。每周排名，并按技术栈、使用场景以及 Cursor 和 Replit 等构建工具打标签。寻找灵感、了解正在发布的产品，并紧跟 AI 生态动态。

payload.name: WoWSQL
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: WoWSQL lets users manage their PostgreSQL database-as-a-service projects directly from ChatGPT. Users can list and inspect projects, browse database tables, execute SQL queries and statements, search platform documentation, read full doc pages, and list file storage buckets — all within their authenticated WoWSQL workspace.
payload.longDescription: WoWSQL 允许用户直接在 ChatGPT 中管理其 PostgreSQL 数据库即服务项目。用户可以列出并检查项目、浏览数据库表、执行 SQL 查询和语句、搜索平台文档、阅读完整文档页面，以及列出文件存储桶，所有操作均在经过身份验证的 WoWSQL 工作区内完成。

payload.name: DNS Inspector
payload.description: 即时查询 DNS 记录
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: DNS Inspector looks up the main DNS record types (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SOA) for any domain and displays them in a clear, readable widget, with one-click refresh and copy-to-clipboard for each value.
payload.longDescription: DNS Inspector 可查询任意域名的主要 DNS 记录类型（A、AAAA、CNAME、MX、TXT、NS、SOA），并通过清晰易读的小组件展示结果；每个值都支持一键刷新和复制到剪贴板。

payload.name: Botpress
payload.description: 可投入生产的 AI 智能体
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Complete AI Agent Platform

Botpress is an all-in-one platform for building AI agents powered by the latest LLMs. Use this application to rapidly prototype agents that can do FAQ, sales, support and so much more!

How it works:
1. Tag @Botpress in your chat and ask ChatGPT to create an agent with Botpress.
2. Iterate on design, business logic, information sources and more through natural language!
3. Once deployed, with the click of a button, you can open your agent in Botpress to access a comprehensive visual agent builder.
payload.longDescription:
完整的 AI 智能体平台

Botpress 是一个一体化平台，用于构建由最新 LLM 驱动的 AI 智能体。使用这款应用快速制作智能体原型，处理常见问题、销售、支持以及更多任务！

使用方式：
1. 在聊天中标记 @Botpress，并请 ChatGPT 使用 Botpress 创建智能体。
2. 通过自然语言迭代设计、业务逻辑、信息来源等！
3. 部署后，只需点击按钮，就可以在 Botpress 中打开智能体，使用全面的可视化智能体构建工具。

payload.name: Outside Agent
payload.description: 构建并发布 AI 智能体
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Outside Agent turns a plain-language brief into a hosted AI agent you can publish to SMS, voice, and web without leaving your coding agent. Describe what the agent should do and it composes the full configuration, grounds it in your own content, runs a safety review, and ships it. Create agents, seed a knowledge base, preview replies before publishing, issue a phone number, and manage everything you’ve built, all through natural conversation.
payload.longDescription: Outside Agent 可将自然语言说明转化为托管式 AI 智能体，无需离开你的编程智能体即可发布到短信、语音和网页渠道。描述智能体应完成的工作，它就会生成完整配置、基于你自己的内容构建知识、进行安全审查并完成发布。你可以创建智能体、填充知识库、在发布前预览回复、申请电话号码，并通过自然对话管理已创建的所有内容。

payload.name: Agent Ready
payload.description: AI 智能体适配扫描器
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Agent Ready checks how readable any website is to AI agents, assistants, and crawlers. Give it a URL and it scans the site against the Vercel Agent Readability Spec, the llms.txt standard, and emerging agent protocols (MCP server cards, A2A agent cards, agents.json), then renders an interactive score card: a 0–100 agent-readability score, an llms.txt score, and a per-check breakdown grouped by site, page, llms.txt, and protocol - each failing check paired with a plain-English fix.

Use it to find out why AI tools can't read your content, validate your llms.txt and AGENTS.md, confirm your structured data and Markdown mirrors, and re-scan any time to check that your fixes landed. Each result links to a full, shareable report on agent-ready.dev. Free to use, no account required.
payload.longDescription:
Agent Ready 检查任何网站对 AI 智能体、助手和爬虫的可读性。提供 URL，它就会根据 Vercel Agent Readability Spec、llms.txt 标准和新兴智能体协议（MCP server cards、A2A agent cards、agents.json）扫描网站，然后呈现交互式评分卡：0–100 的智能体可读性评分、llms.txt 评分，以及按网站、页面、llms.txt 和协议分组的逐项检查明细；每项未通过检查都附有易懂的修复方法。

使用它了解 AI 工具为何无法读取你的内容，验证 llms.txt 和 AGENTS.md，确认结构化数据和 Markdown 镜像，并随时重新扫描，检查修复是否生效。每项结果都链接到 agent-ready.dev 上完整、可分享的报告。免费使用，无需账号。

payload.name: Buildy
payload.description: 面向智能体的个人应用
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Buildy is a hosted runtime for personal web apps that users and their agents can share. An agent creates an app, Buildy gives it a URL, backend, and key-value storage, and the user keeps using the same app and data across ChatGPT, Claude, and other agents.
payload.longDescription: Buildy 是一个托管运行环境，可供用户及其智能体分享个人 Web 应用。智能体创建应用后，Buildy 会为其提供 URL、后端和键值存储；用户随后可在 ChatGPT、Claude 和其他智能体中继续使用同一个应用及其数据。

payload.name: ArmorCodex
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ArmorCodex lets you read, update, and review the policies that govern how AI coding agents interact with tools, files, and infrastructure. Set rules in natural language ("deny webfetch", "require approval for production database changes"), check current policy state, and register intent plans before tool calls run. Built by ArmorIQ for teams that need governance and audit on AI agent activity.
payload.longDescription: ArmorCodex 让你读取、更新和审阅约束AI编程智能体如何与工具、文件和基础设施交互的政策。用自然语言设置规则（“禁止webfetch”“生产数据库变更需要批准”）、检查当前政策状态，并在工具调用执行前登记意图计划。由 ArmorIQ 为需要对AI智能体活动进行治理和审计的团队打造。

payload.name: Alchemy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Alchemy helps developers inspect EVM and Solana blockchain data, manage Alchemy apps and infrastructure, review usage, and configure webhooks and Gas Manager policies through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Alchemy 帮助开发者通过 ChatGPT 查看 EVM 和 Solana 区块链数据，管理 Alchemy 应用及基础设施，查看使用情况，并配置 webhook 和 Gas Manager 策略。

payload.name: IcePanel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
IcePanel is a collaborative diagramming and modelling tool for software architecture. With IcePanel's MCP, bring your software architecture designs into ChatGPT and Codex.

Some cool things you can do with IcePanel's MCP:
- Understand the systems you're building and data flows
- Create model objects and keep them in sync with code
- Manage architecture decision records and ensure they align with what gets built in reality
payload.longDescription:
IcePanel 是一款用于软件架构的协作式绘图与建模工具。借助 IcePanel MCP，你可以将软件架构设计带入 ChatGPT 和 Codex。

使用 IcePanel MCP 可以：
- 理解正在构建的系统及其数据流
- 创建模型对象，并使其与代码保持同步
- 管理架构决策记录，确保其与实际构建内容一致

payload.name: Statsig
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Bring your Statsig workspace into ChatGPT. Product builders can now explore, manage, and create Statsig experiments, feature gates, dynamic configs, and more directly in ChatGPT conversations.

Ask things like:
“Move this experiment to 50% rollout.”
“Turn on this feature gate for all users.”
“Show me which dynamic configs changed this week.”
"Explain how the DAU metric is defined.”

You can both read and write to Statsig: inspect experiment settings, read metric definitions, update allocations, toggle feature flags, edit targeting rules, and modify dynamic config values directly from ChatGPT.

The app connects through Statsig’s MCP server and honors your existing Statsig permissions, so you only see and change what you’re authorized to access—across projects, environments, and teams.
payload.longDescription:
将你的 Statsig 工作区接入 ChatGPT。产品构建者现在可以直接在 ChatGPT 对话中探索、管理和创建 Statsig 实验、功能门控、动态配置等内容。

例如可以询问：
“将此实验的发布比例调整为 50%。”
“为所有用户开启此功能门控。”
“显示本周发生变化的动态配置。”
“解释 DAU 指标的定义。”

你既可以读取也可以写入 Statsig：检查实验设置、查看指标定义、更新分配比例、切换功能标记、编辑定向规则，并直接通过 ChatGPT 修改动态配置值。

此应用通过 Statsig 的 MCP 服务器连接，并遵循你现有的 Statsig 权限；因此，在不同项目、环境和团队中，你只能查看和更改自己获准访问的内容。

payload.name: Val Town
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Val Town helps users create, inspect, run, and deploy apps; manage files, branches, schedules, environment variables, SQLite data, and blob storage; and debug executions through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Val Town 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 创建、检查、运行和部署应用；管理文件、分支、计划任务、环境变量、SQLite 数据和 Blob 存储；并调试执行过程。

payload.name: MiroMiro
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Extract design from any website

MiroMiro lets you pull real design data out of any live website from ChatGPT: brand colors, fonts, logos, design tokens, images, SVGs, and Lottie animations, plus production-ready code rebuilt from actual page sections. Everything comes from the site's real CSS and assets, not screenshots or guesses.

Use it to match a brand, rebuild a section you like, or collect assets for a moodboard, then drop the output straight into your project.

What you can do:

-Extract a complete brand profile from any URL: color palette with roles, fonts, logo and favicon URLs, social profiles, and theme
-Pull a site's design token system (colors, spacing, radii, shadows, typography) as CSS variables or a Tailwind config
-Turn any page section into clean React, Vue, or HTML with Tailwind classes
-List every font a site loads with file URLs, formats, and the CSS stack to replicate it
-Collect all SVG logos and icons as paste-ready code and direct file URLs
-Gather a page's image assets grouped by source (img, srcset, picture, background, favicon, social image) with direct URLs
-Find Lottie animations on a page and get their JSON files

Best for developers, designers, and AI builders who need real design data from live sites instead of eyeballing it.
payload.longDescription:
从任意网站提取设计

MiroMiro 让你可以直接在 ChatGPT 中从任何在线网站提取真实设计数据：品牌颜色、字体、徽标、设计令牌、图片、SVG 和 Lottie 动画，以及根据实际页面区块重建的可用于生产环境的代码。所有内容均来自网站的真实 CSS 和资源，而非截图或猜测。

用它来匹配品牌、重建喜欢的页面区块，或收集情绪板素材，然后将结果直接放入项目。

你可以：

- 从任意 URL 提取完整品牌档案：含用途说明的配色、字体、徽标和网站图标 URL、社交媒体资料及主题
- 提取网站设计令牌系统（颜色、间距、圆角、阴影、字体排印），并导出为 CSS 变量或 Tailwind 配置
- 将页面区块转换为带 Tailwind 类的整洁 React、Vue 或 HTML 代码
- 列出网站加载的所有字体及其文件 URL、格式和用于复刻的 CSS 字体栈
- 收集所有 SVG 徽标和图标，并提供可直接粘贴的代码和文件直链
- 按来源整理网页图片素材（img、srcset、picture、背景、网站图标、社交媒体图片），并提供直链
- 查找网页中的 Lottie 动画并获取其 JSON 文件

最适合需要获取在线网站真实设计数据、而不是凭肉眼估计的开发者、设计师和 AI 创作者。

payload.name: 60fps
payload.description: 搜索真实 iOS 交互
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
60fps is a library of real iOS app interactions, recorded from shipping apps and broken down so
you can build them.

Search in plain language, like "springy bottom sheet" or "pull to refresh with haptics", and get
back matching shots with the app, the gesture, and the motion vocabulary that describes them. Open
one for a frame by frame breakdown of the animation: what moves, in what order, with what timing
and easing. Where a bespoke recreation exists, you can pull compile-checked SwiftUI for it.

It answers the question a reference video cannot: not just what an interaction looks like, but what
it is actually doing.

Read only. It never writes anything and never acts on your behalf.
payload.longDescription:
60fps 是真实 iOS 应用交互的资料库，录制已上线应用的交互，并将其拆解，方便你实现。

用通俗语言搜索，例如“带弹性效果的底部面板”或“带触觉反馈的下拉刷新”，即可获得匹配片段，包含应用、手势及描述动效的术语。打开一个片段，逐帧查看动画的拆解：什么在移动、以什么顺序、采用何种时序和缓动。若有专门重现该交互的实现，你还可以获取经过编译检查的 SwiftUI 代码。

它回答了参考视频无法回答的问题：不只是交互看起来如何，还有它实际在做什么。

只读。它绝不会写入任何内容，也不会代表你采取行动。

payload.name: Honeycomb
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Honeycomb helps users investigate observability data, inspect traces, AI conversations, and anomaly signals, run queries and BubbleUp analyses, manage alerts and dashboards, and follow instrumentation migration guidance through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Honeycomb帮助用户分析可观测性数据，检查追踪数据、AI对话和异常信号，运行查询和BubbleUp分析，管理警报和仪表板，并通过ChatGPT遵循仪器迁移指导。

payload.name: Agiflow
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Agiflow is a shared project board for turning plans into trackable work. Create projects, break them into work units and tasks, set priorities and statuses, assign work, add comments and attachments, and review progress across your workspace. Use Agiflow to plan launches, organize backlogs, run standups, triage incoming work, and keep decisions connected to the tasks they affect. Changes are saved to your authenticated Agiflow workspace, where your team can review and continue the work.
payload.longDescription: Agiflow 是共享项目看板，用于将计划转为可跟踪的工作。创建项目，将其拆分为工作单元和任务，设置优先级和状态，分配工作，添加评论及附件，并查看整个工作区的进度。使用 Agiflow 规划发布、整理待办事项、开展站会、分流新工作，并将决策与其影响的任务关联。修改会保存到你已登录的 Agiflow 工作区，团队可在那里审阅并继续开展工作。

payload.name: Aiven
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Aiven official plugin to provision and manage PostgreSQL, Kafka, and other data services on Aiven. Includes the Aiven MCP Server for project, service, and database management, Kafka topics and connectors, PostgreSQL queries, integrations, and application deployment directly from your AI assistant.
payload.longDescription: Aiven 官方插件，用于在 Aiven 上配置和管理 PostgreSQL、Kafka 及其他数据服务。包含 Aiven MCP Server，可直接通过 AI 助手管理项目、服务和数据库、Kafka 主题和连接器、PostgreSQL 查询、集成以及应用部署。

payload.name: Testifly
payload.description: 将 Testifly 连接到你的智能体
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Testifly helps developers, QA engineers, and product teams validate websites and web applications with automated end-to-end (E2E) testing, website checks, and UI validation directly from a URL. Run browser-based tests to verify user flows, page behavior, redirects, availability, performance, accessibility, and overall site health without any setup. Whether you're testing a production site, staging environment, preview deployment, or local environment, Testifly quickly identifies issues before they reach users.

Testifly is especially valuable for AI-assisted and vibe coding workflows, where code is generated rapidly by AI coding agents. As development accelerates, automated end-to-end validation is critical to ensure features actually work in the browser. Testifly provides an independent verification layer that catches broken user flows, regressions, UI issues, and deployment problems that AI-generated code or unit tests may miss.

Integrated with ChatGPT, Testifly lets you create, run, and analyze end-to-end tests using natural language. It works alongside AI development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, and other coding agents, enabling developers to verify changes continuously without writing test code. Generate structured test reports, validate bug fixes, monitor regressions, and confidently ship high-quality web applications.
payload.longDescription:
Testifly 可帮助开发者、QA 工程师和产品团队直接通过 URL 对网站和 Web 应用执行自动化端到端（E2E）测试、网站检查和 UI 验证。无需任何设置，即可运行基于浏览器的测试，检查用户流程、页面行为、重定向、可用性、性能、无障碍性和网站整体健康状况。无论测试的是生产网站、预发布环境、预览部署还是本地环境，Testifly 都能快速发现问题，避免问题影响用户。

对于 AI 辅助和 vibe coding 工作流，Testifly 尤其有用，因为 AI 编码智能体会快速生成代码。随着开发速度加快，自动化端到端验证对于确保功能确实能在浏览器中正常运行至关重要。Testifly 提供独立验证层，可发现 AI 生成代码或单元测试可能遗漏的用户流程故障、回归问题、UI 问题和部署问题。

Testifly 集成到 ChatGPT 后，你可以用自然语言创建、运行并分析端到端测试。它可与 Claude Code、Cursor、GitHub Copilot、Windsurf 等 AI 开发工具及其他编码智能体协同工作，让开发者无需编写测试代码也能持续验证更改。生成结构化测试报告、验证缺陷修复、监控回归问题，并放心交付高质量 Web 应用。

payload.name: Visily
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bring Visily designs into ChatGPT. Find boards and screens, turn Visily designs into responsive application code, and apply board theme tokens to your project. Connect a Pro or Business workspace with an editor license using OAuth, then share a Visily link or ask for a board by name.
payload.longDescription: 将 Visily 设计带入 ChatGPT。查找画板和屏幕，将 Visily 设计转化为响应式应用代码，并将画板主题令牌应用到你的项目。使用 OAuth 连接具有编辑者许可证的 Pro 或 Business 工作区，然后分享 Visily 链接或按名称请求画板。

payload.name: Sugra API
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Sugra API is intelligence infrastructure for AI agents and decision platforms: one key and one normalized format for cross-domain primary-source data, surfaced to agents through the Model Context Protocol. The connector exposes a small, stable tool surface over the full Sugra catalog of more than 1,300 endpoints aggregating 130+ primary sources across data domains including markets, macroeconomics and central banks, corporate filings, public finance, trade flows, agriculture, climate and natural events, maritime activity, prediction markets, global news, network intelligence, and entity screening. Main workflows: discover endpoints by natural-language search and inspect their schemas, run a one-step find-and-call to retrieve data, pull macroeconomic series and central-bank rates, fetch market prices, history and fundamentals through Sugra Finance, screen a person or organization name against sanctions corpora, resolve free text to a canonical entity, and compose a normalized current view or bounded timeseries for an entity with freshness and provenance. Works with Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and xAI model families and any MCP-enabled client. A free Sugra account is the only connection requirement; the read-only surface never writes, deletes, sends, or publishes.
payload.longDescription: Sugra API 是面向 AI 智能体和决策平台的情报基础设施：通过一个密钥和一种标准化格式获取跨领域的一手来源数据，并通过 Model Context Protocol 提供给智能体。连接器在完整 Sugra 目录之上提供精简、稳定的工具接口；该目录包含 1,300 多个端点，汇集 130+ 个一手来源，覆盖市场、宏观经济和中央银行、企业申报、公共财政、贸易流、农业、气候和自然事件、海事活动、预测市场、全球新闻、网络情报及实体筛查等数据领域。主要工作流包括：通过自然语言搜索发现端点并查看其架构；通过一步式查找并调用来获取数据；提取宏观经济序列和央行利率；通过 Sugra Finance 获取市场价格、历史数据和基本面；根据制裁数据库筛查个人或组织名称；将自由文本解析为规范实体；以及为实体生成包含数据新鲜度和来源信息的标准化当前视图或有限范围时间序列。支持 Anthropic、OpenAI、Google 和 xAI 模型系列，以及任何启用 MCP 的客户端。连接只需免费 Sugra 账户；此只读接口不会写入、删除、发送或发布任何内容。

payload.name: ProductOS
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ProductOS is a remote-first, AI-native development platform. Connect ChatGPT to your entire cloud workspace with no local clone needed. Create and manage projects, boot isolated cloud sandboxes with live preview URLs, read and write files, run a full shell (npm, git, node), provision Postgres databases and S3 storage, and trigger production deploys. Every file change auto-syncs to GitHub. Perfect for rapid prototyping, full-stack development, and team collaboration directly from chat.
payload.longDescription: ProductOS 是一个远程优先、原生支持 AI 的开发平台。无需本地克隆，即可将 ChatGPT 连接到整个云工作区。创建和管理项目、启动带实时预览网址的隔离云沙箱、读写文件、运行完整 Shell（npm、git、node）、配置 Postgres 数据库和 S3 存储，并触发生产部署。每次文件更改都会自动同步到 GitHub。非常适合直接在聊天中快速制作原型、进行全栈开发和团队协作。

payload.name: microfn
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
microfn is a sandboxed cloud environment for building, deploying, and running tiny JavaScript functions - designed to be AI-friendly. Give ChatGPT its own workspace to write functions, deploy them, manage their code and secrets, and run the functions you've already built.

With microfn, ChatGPT can:

- Write and deploy a new JavaScript function on request
- Inspect, update, and validate the code of existing functions
- Manage function settings and secrets securely
- Run your functions and use their results in the conversation

Each function runs in an isolated sandbox, so ChatGPT can safely create and compose its own tools - fetch a weather API, build a key-value store, post to Slack, send a Telegram message, and much more.
payload.longDescription:
microfn 是一个沙盒云环境，用于构建、部署和运行小型 JavaScript 函数，专为 AI 友好场景设计。为 ChatGPT 提供专属工作空间，让它编写函数、部署函数、管理代码和机密信息，并运行你已构建的函数。

使用 microfn，ChatGPT 可以：

- 根据请求编写并部署新的 JavaScript 函数
- 检查、更新并验证现有函数的代码
- 安全管理函数设置和机密信息
- 运行函数，并在对话中使用结果

每个函数都在独立沙盒中运行，因此 ChatGPT 可以安全地创建并组合自己的工具——例如获取天气 API、构建键值存储、向 Slack 发帖、发送 Telegram 消息，以及更多用途。

payload.name: Descope
payload.description: 为应用和 MCP 添加身份验证
payload.summaryOriginal: Add auth to your apps and MCPs
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Descope brings a first-class authentication and identity management experience into ChatGPT. Manage users, tenants, roles, and access control across your Descope projects through natural language. Build and modify auth flows for signup, login, MFA, SSO, and federation without leaving the conversation. Configure auth, consent, and credential management for your MCP servers and AI agents, and easily search Descope documentation when you need guidance.
payload.longDescription: Descope 将一流的身份验证与身份管理体验带入 ChatGPT。通过自然语言管理 Descope 项目中的用户、租户、角色和访问控制。无需离开对话，即可构建和修改注册、登录、多因素身份验证（MFA）、单点登录（SSO）和身份联合流程。为 MCP 服务器和 AI 代理配置身份验证、用户同意及凭据管理；需要指导时，还可以轻松搜索 Descope 文档。

payload.name: Brainbase MCP
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Brainbase MCP lets users create, inspect, update, test, deploy, and monitor managed AI agents from ChatGPT and Codex. It supports revision-safe agent changes, registry skills and MCP server configuration, evaluations, orchestrations, schedules, and task runs, with explicit confirmation for destructive actions and OAuth-based access to the user's Brainbase workspace.
payload.longDescription: Brainbase MCP让用户通过ChatGPT和Codex创建、查看、更新、测试、部署和监控托管AI智能体。它支持能安全处理版本修订的智能体变更、注册表技能和MCP服务器配置、评估、编排、计划安排和任务运行，破坏性操作需要明确确认，并通过基于OAuth的访问连接用户的Brainbase工作空间。

payload.name: Ezoic Setup
payload.description: 在网站上设置 Ezoic 广告
payload.summaryOriginal: Set up Ezoic ads on your site
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Ezoic Setup helps publishers and developers implement Ezoic ads on any site. Ask a question in plain language and it answers with working, copyable code grounded in Ezoic's official documentation, SDKs, and examples - ad placeholders, showAds calls, SPA route-change handling, consent (Gatekeeper) scripts, WordPress and Next.js/React integrations, ads.txt setup, and troubleshooting. It covers JavaScript, React, Vue, Angular, WordPress, and raw HTML sites, and always recommends the cleanest supported integration path for your stack. No account is required to ask questions.
payload.longDescription: Ezoic Setup 帮助发布商和开发者在任何网站上集成 Ezoic 广告。用普通语言提问，它会根据 Ezoic 官方文档、SDK 和示例，给出可运行且可复制的代码，涵盖广告占位符、showAds 调用、SPA 路由切换处理、同意管理（Gatekeeper）脚本、WordPress 和 Next.js/React 集成、ads.txt 设置及故障排查。它支持 JavaScript、React、Vue、Angular、WordPress 和原生 HTML 网站，并始终为你的技术栈推荐最简洁且受支持的集成方式。提问无需账户。

payload.name: Git Diff Patcher Bridge
payload.description: 安全审查 AI 代码补丁
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Git Diff Patcher Bridge connects ChatGPT to GDP through a privacy-bounded MCP endpoint. It can inspect selected repository context, diagnose patches, read local verification evidence, coordinate durable development state, classify restart requirements, compose private evidence-linked Wire drafts, and create reviewable local requests. The hosted connector does not directly apply patches, execute arbitrary shell commands, force-push code, publish public content, or bypass GDP Desktop authority. Repository-changing actions remain behind GDP Desktop review and local execution boundaries. The connector also supports a seeded Demo Workspace for zero-install reviewer and user evaluation.
payload.longDescription: Git Diff Patcher Bridge 通过受隐私范围限制的 MCP 端点，将 ChatGPT 连接到 GDP。它可以检查选定的代码仓库上下文、诊断补丁、读取本地验证证据、协调持久化开发状态、判定重启要求、撰写带私密证据链接的 Wire 草稿，并创建可供审查的本地请求。托管连接器不会直接应用补丁、执行任意 shell 命令、强制推送代码、发布公开内容，也不会绕过 GDP Desktop 的权限控制。所有更改代码仓库的操作仍须经过 GDP Desktop 审查和本地执行边界。连接器还提供预置的 Demo Workspace，供审查者和用户免安装体验。

payload.name: API Documentation Checker
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Extract API contract details, check whether documentation covers the stated API contract, and compare API contract versions. Results are structured, evidence-based, and limited to explicitly provided information.
payload.longDescription: 提取 API 契约详情，检查文档是否涵盖声明的 API 契约，并比较 API 契约版本。结果结构化、以证据为依据，并仅限于明确提供的信息。

payload.name: Manufact
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Manufact lets users deploy, monitor, and manage MCP servers and MCP Apps in Manufact Cloud. The app supports organization lookup, server and deployment management, GitHub repository deployment, build and runtime log inspection, and gateway observability analytics.
payload.longDescription: Manufact允许用户在Manufact Cloud中部署、监控和管理MCP服务器及MCP应用。该应用支持组织查询、服务器和部署管理、GitHub仓库部署、构建和运行时日志检查，以及网关可观测性分析。

payload.name: Charming
payload.description: AI构建应用的安全云平台
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Charming is a hosted runtime for personal web apps that users and their agents can share. An agent creates an app, Charming gives it a URL, backend, and key-value storage, and the user keeps using the same app and data across ChatGPT, Claude, and other agents.
payload.longDescription: Charming是个人网页应用的托管运行时，用户及其代理可以共享该应用。代理创建应用后，Charming会为其分配URL、后端服务和键值存储，用户可在ChatGPT、Claude及其他代理中持续使用同一应用和数据。

payload.name: Alpic
payload.description: 监测 MCP 应用和服务器
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Manage your projects, debug deployment, and check analytics for any MCP server you host with Alpic.
payload.longDescription: 管理项目、调试部署，并查看你通过 Alpic 托管的任何 MCP 服务器的分析数据。

payload.name: Quicknode
payload.description: 面向 OpenAI 构建者的 Quicknode
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Manage your Quicknode infrastructure directly in OpenAI. Create and manage endpoints, monitor logs and usage, configure security and rate limits, and review billing from one conversation.
payload.longDescription: 直接在 OpenAI 中管理 Quicknode 基础设施。在一次对话中创建和管理端点、监控日志与用量、配置安全性和速率限制，并查看账单。

payload.name: Prismic
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Prismic MCP lets users list accessible Prismic repositories, inspect content models (custom types and slices), search and fetch documents, and make release-scoped content changes by creating releases, creating documents, updating documents, and uploading assets to the repository asset library.
payload.longDescription: Prismic MCP 可让用户列出有权访问的 Prismic 存储库、检查内容模型（自定义类型和切片）、搜索并获取文档，以及在指定发布版本范围内进行内容更改，包括创建发布版本、创建文档、更新文档并向存储库的资源库上传文件。

payload.name: MiniUp
payload.description: 将聊天转化为实时网络应用
payload.summaryOriginal: Turn chat into live web apps
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: MiniUp helps users publish simple, modular single-page, and real multi-page no-build web apps from ChatGPT-generated files or uploaded data, host fast queryable datasets and lightweight table APIs, publish ArcGIS-compatible dataset URLs, and manage existing sites, files, gallery listings, records, and datasets from ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: MiniUp帮助用户从ChatGPT生成的文件或上传数据中发布简单、模块化的单页应用和真正的多页无构建网页应用，托管快速可查询的数据集和轻量级表格API，发布与ArcGIS兼容的数据集URL，并从ChatGPT管理现有网站、文件、画廊列表、记录和数据集。

payload.name: Sitelemetry
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Sitelemetry audits websites across security, technical SEO, AI visibility, analytics and tracking integrations, accessibility, and performance. It returns prioritized findings with evidence, impact, and concrete remediation guidance. Public, non-intrusive checks can assess public websites; protected security modules and full audits require a verified Sitelemetry project. Connections use OAuth with PKCE, and private-network targets are blocked. A Sitelemetry account is required; available audits and usage limits reflect the access already assigned to the connected account.
payload.longDescription: Sitelemetry 会从安全、技术 SEO、AI 可见度、分析和跟踪集成、无障碍及性能等方面审计网站，并按优先级返回发现的问题，附上证据、影响和具体修复建议。它可对公开网站进行公开且非侵入式检查；受保护的安全模块和完整审计需要已验证的 Sitelemetry 项目。连接使用带 PKCE 的 OAuth，并会拦截私有网络目标。需要 Sitelemetry 账户；可用审计功能和使用限制取决于已关联账户所获权限。

payload.name: Pathors
payload.description: 构建并部署语音智能体
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Build and deploy production-ready voice AI agents in minutes — no coding required.
payload.longDescription: 几分钟内即可构建并部署可用于生产环境的语音 AI 智能体——无需编写代码。

payload.name: Sprites
payload.description: 为 Codex 配备自己的电脑
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Give your agent its own computer with safety and security. Sprites from Fly are isolated cloud environments with their own filesystem, URL, services, checkpoints, and network policy. This plugin connects Codex to the Sprites MCP server so Codex can manage those remote environments easily.
payload.longDescription: 让智能体拥有一台安全可靠的专属计算机。Fly 的 Sprites 是隔离的云环境，拥有各自的文件系统、URL、服务、检查点和网络策略。此插件将 Codex 连接到 Sprites MCP 服务器，便于 Codex 轻松管理这些远程环境。

payload.name: Vantage
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Vantage is the system of record for allocating and optimizing cloud, SaaS, and AI costs. Vantage has multiple tools for optimizing cloud spend and provides organizations with advanced FinOps workflows and cost governance.
payload.longDescription: Vantage 是用于分摊和优化云、SaaS 及 AI 成本的记录系统。Vantage 提供多种云支出优化工具，并为组织提供高级 FinOps 工作流程和成本治理能力。

payload.name: aictrl.dev
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: aictrl.dev helps engineering teams inspect project context and backlogs, discover governed workflows, start versioned workflow runs, review run evidence, decide approval gates, and cancel active runs through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: aictrl.dev 帮助工程团队通过 ChatGPT 查看项目上下文和待办事项，发现受治理规则约束的工作流，启动带版本记录的工作流运行，审查运行证据，决定审批关卡，以及取消正在进行的运行。

payload.name: Nimble
payload.description: 面向代理的专家级网页搜索
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Nimble gives agents governed, accurate access to the public web, at a lower token cost per answer. Search finds current pages with ranked results and snippets. Extract returns clean, structured content from any URL, including pages needing JavaScript or interaction. Extraction Templates give consistently shaped records from known sites. Web Search Agents handle open-ended work across many sources, returning findings with citations, for research, enrichment, and dataset building.

Also included: ready-made workflows for competitor research, company profiles, meeting prep, market discovery, brand monitoring, SEO, and talent sourcing.
payload.longDescription:
Nimble 以每个答案更低的令牌成本，为代理提供受治理且准确的公共网络访问。Search 会返回带排名结果和摘要的当前页面；Extract 可从任何 URL 提取干净、结构化的内容，包括需要 JavaScript 或交互的页面。Extraction Templates 可从已知网站持续返回形状一致的记录。Web Search Agents 可跨多个来源处理开放式任务，并以引用返回发现，用于研究、丰富和数据集构建。

还包括竞争对手研究、公司画像、会议准备、市场发现、品牌监测、SEO 和人才寻源等现成工作流。

payload.name: Magic Patterns
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Enable your agent to prototype ideas, generate design inspiration, upload local UI, and integrate Magic Patterns designs. The Magic Patterns toolset lets you visually align with your agent on what you want to build.
payload.longDescription: 让你的智能体能够制作创意原型、生成设计灵感、上传本地 UI，并整合 Magic Patterns 设计。Magic Patterns 工具集可帮助你与智能体通过视觉方式确认想要构建的内容。

payload.name: emem
payload.description: 关于真实地点的签名事实
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: emem answers place-based questions with signed Earth-observation and geospatial facts. It can resolve a place, retrieve or materialize available facts, provide verifiable citations, compare similar places, and verify signed receipts.
payload.longDescription: emem 使用经过签名的地球观测和地理空间事实回答地点相关问题。它可以解析地点、检索或生成可用事实、提供可验证的引用、比较相似地点，并验证签名回执。

payload.name: Metaplay SDK Docs
payload.description: 搜索 Metaplay SDK 文档
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Metaplay SDK Docs gives ChatGPT access to Metaplay's LLM-optimized documentation corpus, including SDK source files, sample projects, release notes, CLI reference, and website content across multiple SDK versions. Users can ask natural-language questions and the app retrieves the most relevant articles, reads specific files at requested line ranges, runs ripgrep regex searches, and globs for files by pattern.

payload.name: @imqueue
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
@imqueue is an open-source TypeScript framework for building microservices that
talk over a message queue instead of HTTP — you write a class, decorate the
methods you want to publish, and callers get a fully-typed client generated from
the running service.

This server gives your assistant first-hand knowledge of it, so it writes real
@imqueue code instead of plausible-looking code.

search_docs covers the guides, the tutorial, the CLI manual, the articles, and
every exported symbol of every @imqueue package that publishes an API reference —
so you can ask a question in plain words ("how do I expose a service method?") or
look up an exact signature ("RedisQueue.send", "IMQOptions.safeDelivery"). It
ranks with the same engine imqueue.org's own search uses, so the site and this
server agree about which page answers a question, and licensing and pricing
questions answer from imqueue.com rather than the framework docs. A result can
point at a section rather than a whole page, and get_doc follows that anchor:
give it a URL with a #fragment and it returns just that section, with the heading
path above it and its position on the page, so you can see what was left out and
ask for the rest. Without a fragment it returns the whole page as plain markdown
for reading and quoting. list_packages returns the current package catalogue with
install commands, which is how an assistant picks the right one rather than
guessing at a name. Where two packages cover the same ground — tracing, or the
database layer — the results carry the rule for choosing exactly one, because
installing both breaks quietly rather than loudly.

package_status answers the version question outright: the current version,
licence, minimum Node version and release date of one @imqueue package or of all
of them, read from imqueue.org at the moment you ask rather than recalled. It
also answers for the framework as a whole — the Node and Redis floors, and a
licence note that states the licence terms in a sentence.

scaffold_service generates an idiomatic service — an IMQService subclass with
@expose()d, JSDoc-typed methods plus a bootstrap that starts it — from the method
signatures you describe. A custom return type comes back with the @classType() and
@property() decorators it needs, which matters because a field that lacks them
reaches the generated client typed any and still compiles. scaffold_client shows
how to generate and use the typed client for a service. Both return source text
for you to review and paste; neither writes a file.

All seven tools are read-only. The server has no accounts, no authentication and
no storage: each request is handled statelessly, and the only data it sees is the
argument you send — a search query, a doc URL, a package or service name. Nothing
is retained, and no conversation content is collected or used for training.

Tools that would act on your own machine — driving the imq CLI, creating projects
on disk, starting and stopping your services, reading their logs — are
deliberately not part of this server, because a hosted server cannot reach your
machine and should not claim to. They ship in the local install instead
(npx -y @imqueue/mcp), and local_install_guide returns the setup steps for it.
payload.longDescription:
@imqueue 是一个开源 TypeScript 框架，用于构建通过消息队列而非 HTTP 通信的微服务——您只需编写一个类，对希望公开的方法添加装饰器，调用方将获得从运行中的服务生成的完整类型客户端。

此服务器让您的助手获得第一手知识，因此它会生成真正的@imqueue 代码，而非看起来合理的代码。

search_docs 覆盖指南、教程、CLI 手册、文章以及所有@imqueue 包的导出符号，这些包都提供了 API 参考——因此您可以用自然语言提问（“如何公开服务方法？”）或查找精确的签名（“RedisQueue.send”，“IMQOptions.safeDelivery”）。它使用与 imqueue.org 自身搜索相同的引擎，因此网站和此服务器对问题答案的判断一致，而许可和定价问题则从 imqueue.com 回答而非框架文档。结果可指向页面内的具体章节，get_doc 会跟随该锚点：提供带 #fragment 的 URL 时，它将返回该章节内容，包含上方的标题路径和页面中的位置，方便查看遗漏部分并请求剩余内容。不带 fragment 时则以纯文本格式返回整页内容，便于阅读和引用。list_packages 返回当前的包目录及安装命令，这正是助手选择正确包而非猜测名称的方式。当两个包覆盖相同领域——如追踪或数据库层——结果会携带明确的选包规则，因为
同时安装两者会静默失败而非发出警告。

package_status 直接回答版本问题：某个@imqueue 包或所有包的当前版本、许可证、最低 Node 版本和发布日期，数据来自您提问时的 imqueue.org 而非记忆。它同时回答框架整体信息——Node 和 Redis 的版本要求，以及用一句话说明许可证条款的许可证说明。

scaffold_service 会根据您描述的方法签名生成符合规范的服务——一个带有@expose()装饰的 JSDoc 类型方法的 IMQService 子类，以及启动它的引导代码。自定义返回类型会携带生成客户端所需的@classType()和@property()装饰器，这一点很重要，因为缺少这些装饰器的字段在生成的客户端中会被视为 any 类型但仍能编译通过。scaffold_client 展示了如何为服务生成和使用类型客户端。两者都会返回源代码文本供您查看和粘贴；两者都不会写入文件。

所有七个工具均为只读模式。服务器不包含账户、认证或存储功能：每个请求均无状态处理，服务器看到的唯一数据是您发送的参数——搜索查询、文档 URL、包或服务名称。不会保留任何数据，也不会收集或使用对话内容进行训练。

那些需要在您本地机器上运行的工具——例如操作imq命令行界面、在磁盘上创建项目、启动和停止服务、读取日志等——被有意排除在该服务器之外，因为托管服务器无法访问您的机器，也不应声称具备此能力。这些工具实际通过本地安装提供（npx -y @imqueue/mcp），本地安装指南则提供了相应的设置步骤。

payload.name: FlawPilot
payload.description: 网站安全与 SEO 扫描器
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: FlawPilot connects ChatGPT to your website health scans. Ask ChatGPT to scan any live URL, and FlawPilot checks it for security vulnerabilities, performance bottlenecks, infrastructure issues, and SEO problems. ChatGPT can list your existing projects, start a new scan, and check scan status until results are ready with prioritized scores and actionable insights, all without leaving your conversation.
payload.longDescription: FlawPilot 将 ChatGPT 连接到你的网站健康扫描。让 ChatGPT 扫描任意在线 URL，FlawPilot 就会检查安全漏洞、性能瓶颈、基础设施问题和 SEO 问题。无需离开对话，ChatGPT 就可以列出你现有的项目、启动新扫描，并持续检查扫描状态，直到结果就绪；结果会包含优先级评分和可执行的洞察。

payload.name: NORMS: Evidence & Scope
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: NORMS assesses whether structured, ratified normative records have sufficient verified grounds for a declared purpose. It checks explicit authority, temporal applicability, scope, verification, provision segmentation and structured conditions, then reports blockers, unknowns and unexamined areas. Missing or unverified required grounds fail closed. NORMS does not provide legal advice, certify compliance, parse PDFs or documents, retrieve laws, infer normative conditions from free text, approve contracts or modify external data.
payload.longDescription: NORMS 用于评估结构化且已批准的规范记录，是否为已声明用途提供了充分且经过验证的依据。它会检查明确授权、时间适用性、范围、验证、条款拆分和结构化条件，然后报告阻塞项、未知事项和未经检查的领域。缺少所需依据或依据未经验证时，系统将拒绝放行。NORMS 不提供法律建议或合规认证，不解析 PDF 或其他文档，不检索法律，不会从自由文本推断规范条件，也不批准合同或修改外部数据。

payload.name: StubEngine
payload.description: 启动实时 API 模拟
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
StubEngine helps companies speed up API delivery by turning plain-English requirements into live API mocks. Users can generate valid mock APIs and manage everything in a shared business workspace.
Whether you need a single mocked endpoint or a full API project with related endpoints, StubEngine makes it faster to prototype, test and ship integrations.
By reducing manual setup and accelerating mock creation, teams can move from idea to working API simulation in minutes.
payload.longDescription:
StubEngine 帮助企业将通俗语言描述的需求转化为实时 API 模拟，从而加快 API 交付。用户可以生成有效的模拟 API，并在共享业务工作区中统一管理。
无论你需要模拟单个端点，还是包含相关端点的完整 API 项目，StubEngine 都能加快集成的原型设计、测试和发布。
通过减少手动设置并加快模拟创建，团队可以在几分钟内从想法推进到可运行的 API 模拟。

payload.name: Agent Community
payload.description: 成员查询和 DMV 工具
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Look up a known Agent Community member by exact name or slug, read the roughly-live community count, explicitly pre-register a proposed .agent identity, and verify live DMV certificate issuance. Broad directory search is intentionally unsupported. Pre-registration is free and non-binding, does not confer domain ownership, and the proposed .agent TLD remains pending ICANN approval.
payload.longDescription: 通过准确姓名或 slug 查询已知的 Agent Community 成员，读取近实时社区人数，明确预注册拟议的 .agent 身份，并核验实时 DMV 证书签发情况。应用有意不支持广泛的目录搜索。预注册免费且不具约束力，不授予域名所有权，拟议的 .agent 顶级域名仍在等待 ICANN 批准。

payload.name: SiteTriage
payload.summaryOriginal: Find out why a site is broken
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Your site just broke — ask SiteTriage why. Give it a URL or domain and it runs live, read-only diagnostics from the edge: DNS resolution and propagation, the exact TLS certificate the server is presenting right now (including TLS 1.3), HTTP status and redirect chains, email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), and domain registration and expiry. It then returns the most likely root cause, ranked, with concrete fix steps — instead of guesses. Ideal for the deploy moment: apex-vs-www misconfigurations, stale DNS after a host migration, propagation lag, certificate errors, redirect loops, and emails landing in spam. Stateless and anonymous: no accounts, no stored data.
payload.longDescription: 网站刚刚出故障？问问 SiteTriage。提供 URL 或域名后，它会从网络边缘运行实时只读诊断：DNS 解析与传播情况、服务器当前提供的确切 TLS 证书（包括 TLS 1.3）、HTTP 状态码和重定向链、邮件身份验证（SPF、DKIM、DMARC），以及域名注册和到期时间。随后它会对最可能的根本原因进行排序，并提供具体修复步骤，而不是猜测。适合部署时排查：主域名与 www 配置错误、迁移主机后的 DNS 过期、传播延迟、证书错误、重定向循环，以及邮件进入垃圾邮件。无状态且匿名：无需账户，不存储数据。

payload.name: Opscotch
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:

The server is designed for developers using AI coding assistants, and automation engineers who want to build or maintain Opscotch solutions using natural language.

- answer questions about the Opscotch platform
- explain APIs, configuration, and runtime behaviour
- author workflows and bootstrap configurations
- validate workflow structure and configuration
- assist with packaging, deployment, and licensing
- provide guidance using the latest platform capabilities
- generate examples and implementation patterns

With MCP, the AI can use purpose-built tools that understand the Opscotch platform, resulting in responses that are:

- more accurate
- aware of current platform features
- capable of structured authoring rather than just producing text
- less prone to hallucinating APIs or configuration

Typical use cases
- "Create a workflow that polls an HTTP endpoint every minute."
- "Why won't this bootstrap validate?"
- "Generate a workflow that receives webhooks and forwards them to AWS SQS."
- "Explain this JavaScript processor."
- "Help migrate this workflow to the latest Opscotch version."
- "Help me generate a signed package for deployment."

The server is intended for:

- AI coding assistants
- IDE integrations
- CLI agents
- automation developers
- DevOps and platform engineers
- custom AI applications that need authoritative knowledge of Opscotch
payload.longDescription:
Opscotch MCP Server 为 AI 助手提供直接访问 Opscotch 知识和创作工具的能力。

该 MCP 服务器提供结构化工具，帮助 AI 助手理解、创作、验证并处理 Opscotch 应用和工作流。

- 解释 API、配置和运行时行为
- 编写工作流和引导配置
- 验证工作流结构与配置
- 协助打包、部署和许可
- 根据平台最新功能提供指导

通过 MCP，AI 可以使用专为理解 Opscotch 平台而打造的工具，从而让回答：

- 更准确

该服务器面向：

- AI 编程助手

- CLI 智能体
- 自动化开发者
- DevOps 和平台工程师
- 需要 Opscotch 权威知识的定制 AI 应用

Access to expert, 24x7 Scrum and agile coaching, expert level user story splitting, product backlog item generation and access to your Mountain Goat Software video course library, right inside ChatGPT.

payload.name: ConsentLayer

payload.longDescription: ConsentLayer 帮助网站所有者通过 ChatGPT 设置和管理符合 GDPR、CCPA 和 LGPD 要求的 Cookie 同意机制。它可以配置网站、扫描跟踪技术、设置同意类别和横幅行为、生成安装代码片段、验证线上安装情况，并管理持续合规工作流，例如扫描器审核、地理位置规则、Cookie 政策和 Do Not Sell 请求。

payload.name: zyberspace
payload.description: 在 ChatGPT 中创建网站
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
ZyberSpace lets you create and publish professional business websites in minutes. Describe your business, choose your style, and ZyberSpace turns it into a live, mobile and agent-ready website.

Go beyond basic online presence. With ZyberSpace, local businesses can launch service pages, landing pages, lead-generation sites, portfolios, restaurant pages, salon websites, contractor websites, and small business websites designed to attract customers.

payload.name: BasicDeploy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:

Through the connector, the assistant can create containers, deploy a project, run shell commands, and read logs. You can also add hosted sign-up and login to the apps you build over standard OpenID Connect, so your app gets its own users without writing an auth system. You sign in once with your BasicDeploy account — no API key to paste. Pricing is a flat monthly rate that includes the database, storage, bandwidth, and URL.
